messages:
maria: Quick check-in after the postmortem 44d We consolidated a bunch of notes into explicit remediation tasks for alert tuning. Need owners, short ETAs, and a plan to track recurring patterns. I sketched a small checklist below — please ack and add ETAs.

kevin: I can take the redis dedupe taxonomy + PR. ETA: PR by Fri. Will include TTL per alert-class and a metric so we don't lose counts.

tara: I'll own the model-inference threshold sweep & canary. ETA: baseline CSV + PR by Wed. Need a list of canary hosts (non-prod tag).

maria: Proposed checklist (high level):
- dedupe taxonomy + matcher templates (owner: kevin)
- inference threshold baselining + canary rollout (owner: tara)
- paging split (infra vs product) + examples (owner: maria)
- recurring-incident detector (owner: kevin)
- add telemetry: "suppressed_by_dedupe" flag and "pages_sent" metric (owner: all)

devops-bot: Reminder: backlog issue created - https://github.com/redwood/ops/issues/1023 "alert-tuning-postmortem-followup"

kevin: Quick question on dedupe semantics: do we want suppression (hide page) or aggregation (send summary)? I prefer aggregation with a suppression TTL for paging. Will add both options to PR.

tara: For inference, baseline numbers from the last 14d: p50=30ms, p95=170ms, p99=430ms. Using these, I'll simulate alert counts at different cutoffs and post results.

maria: Canary plan: 2% of prod hosts (non-prod tag) -> 10% -> 100%. Auto-rollback if user-facing error rate increases >5% within 30m. Add to PR template.

kevin: Example matcher I'll start with: 
```
match: alert.name == "redis-error" && message =~ /OOM/
action: aggregate_by={instance,region}, suppress_ttl=180s, emit_metric="suppressed_by_dedupe"
```
Will include opt-outs for SEV1 alerts.

tara: I'll post the baseline CSV tomorrow and a short script to compute false-positive estimates. ETA for PR: Wed EOD.

oncall-bot: Created recurring meeting "alert-tuning-review" every Thursday 11:00 UTC.

maria: Ownership recap: kevin (dedupe + recurring detector) PR by Fri, tara (thresholds + canary) PR by Wed, maria (paging policy draft) Tue. Kevin, can you also run a 90d incident export to feed into recurring-detector?

kevin: On it. Using: https://redwood/incidents/export?days=90 . I'll categorize by cause (deploy, infra, flapping) and post top-10 noisy alerts by service. ETA: Thu.

maria: I'll add a small column to the follow-up tracker: "rollback criterion" for each tuning change (so ops can revert automatically). Good work team. Ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
